thought.text: PHP 8.4.24 is available and settings.php is linked. Now running the documented site installation command.

reasoning_content: The settings.php symlink is already in place, and PHP 8.4.24 is running inside the container. Now I'll run the documented install command: `ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config`. This runs the `openculturas` profile installation. It could take a few minutes. I'll run it in the background and poll for progress.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup runuser -u dev -- ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config > /tmp/site_install.log 2>&1 &
echo "started PID $!"
